entities.name: Margaret, Maid of Norway
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Margaret, known as the Maid of Norway, was the queen-designate of Scotland from 1286 until her death. As she was never inaugurated, her status as monarch is uncertain and has been debated by historians.
